beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Anti-Trivialization Machines of the Future asks who protects judgment when convincing answers become cheap.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This institutional argument moves beyond telling distracted people to exercise more discipline.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It proposes attention rules that could make AI answerable to our declared purposes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: You gain ways to distinguish helpful assistance from systems competing to keep you occupied.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Consider the book's proposal for an agent governed by a person's attention policy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: During protected study, medical alerts could arrive immediately while workplace requests wait.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The person declares those priorities before another application demands an immediate response.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Applications would negotiate with that agent instead of competing directly for attention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Protection comes from enforceable conditions, rather than repeatedly resisting each interruption alone.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book also asks whose interests the supposedly personal assistant actually serves.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An examination tutor should support learning, rather than secretly maximize time spent online.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its main objectives should be inspectable, including conflicts with commercial incentives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The user must also remain able to change goals and allow unexpected interruptions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That makes protection a revisable delegation, rather than surrendering judgment to another gatekeeper.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same argument expands from personal interruptions to institutions making consequential decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Faster AI analysis does not make a forest grow or infrastructure age faster.
